column1: # Words that open a flat, office or floor designator, and its kind: data of the engine, read for every sheet alike.
# A word counts only when the token after it is a number, a number with a letter, or one or two letters ("apt 4B",
# "Suite 300", "kv. 12"); inside a street name ("Unit Street") it is not one.
# Cyrillic words live in extras.rs (UNIT_WORDS_CYRILLIC): the public text of this file is Latin only.
